title: Place Your Story on a World Map
use_cases: Use when mapping physical relationships between story locations
Implement when visualizing character travel routes or distances
Configure when uploading custom hand-drawn or AI-generated fantasy maps
Use when organizing world-building entries geographically
content:
Drag every location onto an interactive canvas. Upload your own atlas or use the built-in grid. Distances, regions, and travel routes — all visual, all persistent.

![World Map — drag-and-drop locations onto a custom atlas inside the codex](https://proseengine.app/assets/landing-codex-world-map.png?v=1)

🗺

Bring Your Own Atlas

Upload a hand-drawn or AI-generated map — or start from a blank grid

📍

Drag-and-Drop Places

Drop any place entry onto the canvas; positions persist across sessions

🧭

Spatial Story Sense

See at a glance which places are near, far, or unreachable for each character
